question: The world's first official airmail was sent from ________ to ________ in February 1911.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Allahabad, Naini**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The world's first official airmail flight took place in India on **18 February 1911**, a journey of **18 kilometres** (11 mi) lasting 27 minutes across the **from Allahabad to Naini**.
 
• Only floating post office of India Post is situated in Srinagar, Kashmir which was inaugurated in August 2011 at Dal Lake.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The speed post service was introduced in India in 1986 by the department of India Post.
 
• It is used for the purpose of the faster delivery of parcels, letters, cards, documents, and other important stuff.
 
• India Post started this service under the name of the "EMS Speed Post".
 
• The present headquarter of India post is situated at Dak Bhawan, Sansad Marg, New Delhi.
